entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JsonPatch: `move` still adds the value at `path` when removing it from `from` failed #69904
  • JsonPatch (Newtonsoft.Json): values are converted under the `ContractResolver` alone, and the converter's error is swallowed #69903
  • JsonPatch (Newtonsoft.Json): `copy`, `test` and dictionary keys ignore the document's `ContractResolver` #69902
  • Blazor static form mapping: an empty field cannot bind `null` to a nullable custom `IParsable<T>` struct #69901
  • RouteView keeps a stale Body when a page that was a layout becomes the routed page, rendering it twice #69900
  • Harden JWT-formatted OpenID Connect UserInfo responses #69895
  • Allow overriding SupportedCultures when so desired #69887
  • Add WebSocket, EventSource, and sendBeacon APIs #69885
  • Add MessageChannel and BroadcastChannel support #69884
  • Add AbortController and AbortSignal support #69883
  • Add Fetch, Headers, Request, and Response APIs #69882
  • Add URL and URLSearchParams support #69881
  • Add Credentials and WebAuthn support #69880
  • Add Web Locks support #69876
  • Add storage management APIs #69875
  • Add Cache Storage support #69874
  • Add IndexedDB support #69873
  • Add browser context and capability APIs #69872
  • Blazor auto-pause fails after navigating to static SSR #69869
